title: Just Intonation vs Equal Temperament
summary: A short demonstration comparing just intonation with equal temperament, played so you can hear how the tuning compromise changes intervals and chords. It includes a Bach prelude played in both tunings.
why: Shared as a quick audible demonstration of the errors that equal temperament introduces compared with pure intervals.

quote.text: this video is a great demonstration of the errors between just intonation intervals and our equal temperament compromise
